title: SIDESTORY: UNDER TIDES OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: UNDER TIDES OPEN
EVENT DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 11, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Under Tides event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Deserted Salviento] Duration: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Choppy Ruin] Duration: October 28, 2021, 16:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[TRY TO SURVIVE]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Try to Survive] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★★: Gladiia, Iberian Resort Town Furniture (Pieces), Corrupted Iberian Records.
[BARTER]
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 11, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Corrupted Iberian Records by clearing event stages and Try to Survive missions. Corrupted Iberian Records can be used to redeem items from [Barter].
MAIN REWARDS: Gladiia's Token, Iberian Resort Town Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
NOTE:
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
After the event ends, the event stages will be permanently added to Intermezzi.
02 LIMITED HEADHUNTING OPEN – DEEP DROWN LAMENT
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited Headhunting, "Deep Drown Lament", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Skadi the Corrupting Heart [Limited] / Kal'tsit (70% in 6* Operators)
★★★★★: Akafuyu (50% in 5* Operators)
★★★★★★: W [Limited] (Rate up in the rest 30% in 6* Operators)
NOTE:
"Deep Drown Lament" belongs to "Limited Headhunting: Celebration."
"Limited Headhunting: Celebration" is "Limited Headhunting."
Operator Kal'tsit and Operator Akafuyu will appear at "Deep Drown Lament", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
Limited Operator Skadi the Corrupting Heart can ONLY be obtained from "Limited Headhunting: Celebration" and will NOT appear in other Standard Headhunting.
03 LIMITED-TIME LOG-IN EVENT OPEN
<EVENT 1>
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Song of the Sea Headhunting Permit] * 1 as login reward.
NOTE:
- [Song of the Sea Headhunting Permit] can only be used in Limited Headhunting "Deep Drown Lament."
- This login reward can only be obtained once for each account.
- [Song of the Sea Headhunting Permit] will be expired at November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
<EVENT 2>
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can do one free roll in "Deep Drown Lament" every day.
NOTE:
- The free roll will be refreshed at 04:00 every day.
- The unused free roll chance will be refreshed at 04:00 each day and thus cannot be accumulated.
04 LIMITED-TIME SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can sign in for 10 days to earn the following rewards:
Top Emergency Sanity Potion, Originite Prime, Spot's Outfit, Elite Materials, etc.
Day 1: LMD * 30000, Supporter Chip * 2
Day 2: LMD * 30000, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2
Day 3: Orundum * 200, Pure Gold * 25
Day 4: Originite Prime * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 5: Skill Summary – 2 * 15, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2
Day 6: Originite Prime * 1, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 7: LMD * 30000, Orundum * 200
Day 8: Chip Catalyst * 1, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2
Day 9: Originite Prime * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 15
Day 10: Expedited Plan * 5, Bloodline of Combat Collection – Professional for Spot * 1
NOTE:
- The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will be expired at November 8, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
- Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
05 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "Deep Drown Lament."
★★★★★★: Skadi the Corrupting Heart [Limited] / Kal'tsit
★★★★★: Akafuyu
NOTE:
- Operator Gladiia is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Under Tides and is NOT available in "Deep Drown Lament" or any Standard Headhunting.
- Skadi the Corrupting Heart, Kal'tsit, Akafuyu, and Gladiia will gain more trust during October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).

- Limited Headhunting 'Deep Drown Lament' includes Operator Skadi's Alternate form, Skadi the Corrupting Heart, as a Limited Operator. Since an Operator's original form and Alternate form cannot share outfits, therefore, we will grant an [Outfit Voucher] to players who have purchased Skadi's outfit [Waverider WR04] with Originiums before Skadi the Corrupting Heart is released in-game.
Content: [Outfit Voucher]*1
Date: October 23, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) (Please log in again if you fail to find it in Mail)
To: Players who have purchased Skadi's outfit [Waverider WR04] with Originiums before Skadi the Corrupting Heart is released in-game.
06 BLOODLINE OF COMBAT COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Dark Cloud for Mountain
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Forgemaster for Eunectes
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Gorgeous Flower for Flint
Bloodline of Combat Collection - Tested One for Ayerscarpe
In addition, the following Re-edition Outfit will also be available at the Store:
EPOQUE [Passe] Series Selects - Fugue for W
07 AMBIENCE SYNESTHESIA COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Ambience Synesthesia Collection - Burst Feline for Blaze
Ambience Synesthesia Collection - Speechless Sound for Courier
Ambience Synesthesia Collection - Black Wave for Vigna
08 NEW FURNITURE SET – IBERIAN RESORT TOWN
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Iberian Resort Town, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Under Tides event rewards and redeem in Barter (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
09 CAUTUS VALLEY MINING AREA OPEN
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 4, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can get one trial to mine in Cautus Valley Mining Area after daily login. Each time, players will randomly discover one of the following types of ore: Originium Crude Ore, Originium Ore, and Originium Vein. The ores from mining will be automatically processed into Orundums.
NOTE:

- Originium Crude Ore is worth 300 Orundums, Originium Vein is worth 1800 Orundums, and Originium Ore's value varies between Originium Crude Ore and Originium Vein, the exact value of which will be shown after it has been processed.
- The one daily trial will be refreshed at 04:00 on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
- If the trial fails to reach a Vein, the chance to encounter an Originium Vein will increase on the next attempt.
- If no Originium Veins are found before the access period ends, professionals will be there to guide the Rhodes Island prospecting team to the location of an Originium Vein on the last day.
10 RHODES ISLAND RESOURCE PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DETAILS: During the event, these following packs will be available at Store for a limited time.
[ID INFO UPDATE CARD PACK] (FREE)
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: ID Info Update Card * 1
[ID INFO UPDATE CARD PACK]
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: ID Info Update Card * 1
[RHODES ISLAND HEADHUNTING PACK]
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 18, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Top Operator Transfer Permit * 1, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1
[Top Operator Transfer Permit]: Players can select one 6* Operator from a past Standard Headhunting Pool up to and including "Fractured Light."

(Ch'en, Blaze, Exusiai, Siege, Ifrit, Hoshiguma, Shining, SilverAsh, Nightingale, Eyjafjalla, Hellagur, Saria, Mostima, Bagpipe, Aak, Magallan, Phantom, Skadi, Angelina, Schwarz, Ceobe, Weedy, Rosa, Suzuran, Thorns, Eunectes, Surtr, Blemishine)
[RHODES ISLAND RESOURCE PACK]
DURATION: October 21, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – November 18, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 90, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, Chip Catalyst * 4, LMD * 200000, Strategic Battle Record * 30, Tactical Battle Record * 50, Skill Summary – 3 * 30, Skill Summary – 2 * 50, Furniture Part * 500
11 NEW ANNIHILATION – FLOODED SEASHORE
DURATION: November 1, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7) – January 10, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-8
DETAILS: Abandoned Mine will be replaced by New Annihilation Mission Flooded Seashore. Abandoned Mine will be added to the list of Hypothetical Annihilation Targets after it ends.
12 ANNIHILATION MISSIONS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DURATION: November 1, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7) – November 29, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: All Annihilation Missions stay open during the period above.
